caption: The drawing features two rectangular, gray stone blocks placed side by side on a plain, off-white background. The larger block is on the left, while the smaller block sits to the right, slightly lower in height so their top surfaces form a step-like arrangement. Both blocks have a textured, rough appearance with subtle vertical and horizontal striations resembling wood grain or weathered stone. On the face of the larger block, toward the bottom center, there is a carved or relief image of a horse standing on a small platform. The horse faces left, depicted in a side profile with details including its mane, legs, and tail. On the front face of the smaller block, there is a faint marking or inscription with the numbers "312" visible on the right side. The overall color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of gray and neutral tones. There are no additional objects or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Stepping Stone
